artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background. A graded poset $P = \bigsqcup_{n\ge 0} P_n$ with $|P_0|=1$ is called $r$-differential (in the sense of Fomin/Stanley) if its up- and down-operators $U,D\colon \mathbb{C}P \to \mathbb{C}P$, defined by $Ux = \sum_{y \gtrdot x} y$ and $Dx = \sum_{y \lessdot x} y$, satisfy $DU - UD = r\,\mathrm{Id}$. The Young lattice $\mathbb{Y}^{(r)}$ consisting of all integer partitions with at most $r$ rows, ordered by inclusion of Young diagrams, is known to be $r$-differential. From the general theory of $r$-differential posets one obtains an RSK-type bijection between $r$-colored permutations of $\{1,\dots,n\}$ (i.e., pairs $(\sigma, c)$ where $\sigma \in S_n$ and $c\colon\{1,\dots,n\}\to\{1,\dots,r\}$, equivalently elements of the wreath product $\mathbb{Z}/r\mathbb{Z} \wr S_n$) and pairs $(P,Q)$ of suitably weighted standard tableaux of the same shape $\lambda \in \mathbb{Y}^{(r)}$ with $|\lambda| = n$.

Problems.
(1) Define a notion of jeu de taquin for standard (and skew) Young tableaux whose shapes are restricted to lie in $\mathbb{Y}^{(r)}$, in such a way that it interacts compatibly with the above RSK-type correspondence on $r$-colored permutations, in analogy with classical jeu de taquin for Young diagrams and Sagan–Worfley's jeu de taquin for shifted Young diagrams.

(2) Formulate and prove a Greene-type invariant for $r$-colored permutations: i.e., describe an explicit combinatorial statistic on $r$-colored permutations (analogous to the maximum total length of a union of $k$ increasing subsequences in the classical Greene theorem) whose value depends only on the insertion tableau $P$ produced by the above RSK algorithm, and which characterizes the shape of $P$. Equivalently, give a combinatorial description of the equivalence relation on $r$-colored permutations consisting of those producing the same $P$-tableau.
artifact.status_search_result: The problems are posed as open in a recent (2025) collection of open problems on tableaux combinatorics. A targeted web search did not return any work establishing a jeu de taquin theory or a Greene-type invariant for the RSK correspondence on $r$-colored permutations arising from the $r$-differential structure of the lattice of partitions with at most $r$ rows. Status appears open.
